Title: Unfolding and Shrinking Neural Machine Translation Ensembles
This paper presents an alternative to knowl- edge distillation as we aim to speed up decoding to be comparable to single NMT while retaining the boost in translation accuracy from the ensem- ble. In a ﬁrst step, we describe how to construct a single large neural network which imitates the output of an ensemble of multiple networks with the same topology. We will refer to this process as unfolding.
